subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed server-side tools be hidden unless the active model provider is positively `xai`, including missing-provider contexts, or should OpenClaw preserve an explicit cross-provider opt-in?
rationale: This PR changes provider/auth tool availability for existing xAI-key users, and repository policy treats fail-closed provider routing and auth-provider behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
options.body: Keep the PR direction, but require real factory tests and current-head tool-resolution proof before merge.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve intentional cross-provider xAI tool use behind a documented setting or allowlist instead of exposing it from credential presence alone.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Leave the linked issue open for provider-billed tool policy if maintainers are not ready to choose the default in this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR direction, but require real factory tests and current-head tool-resolution proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the xAI `x_search` plugin move and adjacent plugin tool context that the policy depends on.
